note: Hand-set v1 weights (doc: Davel - Ham muc tieu v1). Units of U = the top candidate score of the pool. 24/11 after the held-out runs: beta.market 2.0 (Cho Han + Cho Con on one day in 17/120 plans), beta.history 1.5 (two museums in 9/120), kappa 0.6/1.2/2.0 (28/120 plans over the template pace ceiling). tau 0.014 = the legacy edge travel weight of balanced/experience (~0.006 U/min) folded into T9, now the only place riding minutes cost. profiles: the three plans of a request are this objective under three weight sets. experience keeps the legacy 2.5x diversity; savings keeps its legacy edge travel weight (~0.038 U/min, tau 0.045) and doubles the pace penalty (its free stops all score near U). 24/11 step 1: dup_* = T11 near-duplicates (same alt_group, a whole-area stop + a stop inside it, a second daytime market, two meals of one dish; 0.5 stays below the dinner bonus so a day never drops a meal to avoid a repeat). meal_bonus.dinner 0.8 -> 1.2: a day that spans the evening ate no dinner in 6/26 held-out plans (legacy 0/25), its last sight (river cruise, Cầu Rồng) was worth more than 0.8U (1.5 also fixed it but left a beach on a rainy day of a 2-day trip under the 5-unit search), counted on the day so a stop slipped in between does not escape. To be replaced by learned weights (same keys, new file). 25/11 step 4: `value` = the weights of T1, one function for every profile (value.py): v_i = sum of place features (base, fee, rating, fame, novelty, free, free_outdoor; fee is a cost) + U0 x the traveller's (taste, spending, outdoor, liked), U0 = the pool's top place value. The shared block is balanced; savings and experience override single keys in profiles.<name>.value. The numbers are the pre-v1 node scores, except that savings no longer charges its mean matrix leg in v_i (T9 charges riding): cap_avg_leg (1/60 per minute) only ranks its candidate cap. 26/11: price_level dropped from T1 (on danang-v2 it is the price tier again, the source of fee: two collinear columns cannot be learned apart; 52/60 savings days kept their stops). Kept on evidence: cap_avg_leg (without it savings J is lower on 53/60 days) and free_outdoor (it brings the beaches, nature and markets of savings: 60 -> 38 such stops without it).
